name: rf_base
source: mean over 50 synthetic panels of mean interest_rate / 100

name: macro_spread_base
source: mean over 50 synthetic panels of mean credit_spread / 100

name: gdp_growth_base
source: mean over 50 synthetic panels of mean gdp_growth / 100 (enters only as scenario shift)

name: price_floor
source: price of default risk = max(lam_cs x k_cs, 1): priced spread never below expected loss

name: alpha_min
source: assumed; distress cost at full tangibility

name: alpha_max
source: assumed; distress cost at zero tangibility

name: recovery_min
source: assumed; recovery at zero tangibility

name: recovery_max
source: assumed; recovery at full tangibility

name: x_grid
source: feasible range of the original specification

name: band
source: near-optimal band = WACC within 10 bp of minimum

name: cal_seeds
source: panel seeds for calibration uncertainty

name: tau
source: MC range U[0.15, 0.3]. Corporate tax rate. Base = DGP tax_rate (US federal statutory rate since 2018); range covers effective to combined federal+state rates.

name: erp
source: MC range U[0.04, 0.07]. Equity risk premium. Base = DGP erp.

name: beta_u
source: MC range U[0.8, 1.2]. Unlevered (asset) beta, common to all sectors. Base = DGP beta0 (equity beta at zero leverage).

name: rf_shift
source: MC range U[-0.01, 0.01]. Additive shift to the risk-free rate (decimal) on top of the scenario level.

name: sigma_bar
source: MC range U[0.18, 0.35]. Cross-sector average asset volatility (annual). Sector sigma_A = sigma_bar x relative earnings volatility. Assumed; range spans typical estimates for US non-financial firms.

name: s0
source: MC range U[0.003, 0.01]. Credit spread at negligible default risk (decimal). Assumed (roughly AA/AAA spread level).

name: lam_cs
source: MC range U[1.5, 4.0]. Ratio of credit spread to annual expected loss at base macro conditions (credit-risk premium multiplier). Assumed; spreads exceed expected losses (credit-spread puzzle). Scenario price = max(lam_cs x k_cs, 1).

name: alpha_scale
source: MC range U[0.5, 1.5]. Multiplier on sector distress cost alpha_s (fraction of unlevered value lost in default).

name: recov_shift
source: MC range U[-0.1, 0.1]. Additive shift to sector recovery rate R_s (LGD_s = 1 - R_s).

name: T
source: MC range U[3.0, 10.0]. Debt horizon in years (Merton horizon, tax-shield horizon, spread annualisation).

name: mu_shift
source: MC range U[-0.02, 0.02]. Additive shift to the sector asset drift mu_s (decimal).

name: g_to_mu
source: MC range U[0.0, 1.0]. Asset-drift response to the scenario GDP shift (mu_s += g_to_mu x dGDP). Assumed. Base 0.5 = GDP loading of stock returns in the DGP code (stock_return = N(0.08, 0.25) + 0.5 gdp/100); the DGP's direct ROA loading is 0.02 (roa = prof + 0.02 gdp/100 + noise); 1 = one-for-one mapping; 0 = drift channel switched off.
